name: GTG-27005
description: Anthropic disrupted likely freelance Russia-based actors building a full-stack autonomous FPV kamikaze drone swarm via Claude Code — shared swarm memory/fault-tolerant coordination logic, an onboard small language model governing attack/observe/return-to-base behavior (including a "person" target class able to issue detonation commands without a human in the loop), camera-based terminal guidance, a control-link geolocation module to find opposing drone operators, passive acoustic detection, and low-level programmable-chip logic. The team trained a computer-vision classifier on scraped Ukrainian combat footage and used a fixed Donetsk Oblast coordinate as a demonstration strike point; systems reached TRL 3–4 (validated in simulation; confirmed hardware-in-the-loop testing). 9 accounts identified (8 used only for ordinary freelance work); unverified claimed funding ties to Russia's Advanced Research Foundation, National Technology Initiative, and Ministry of Defence.
